 "rationale": "A PMOS input stage cannot work, because Vsg is about 1 V while only 0.72 V is available at 1.62 V. So the input is an NMOS pair. Its short-L PMOS mirror limits gain to about 13, which keeps the high-impedance node fast (tau under 1 ns). The second PMOS stage matches the mirror density and gain is about 8; the inverter gives the rail-to-rail swing. Budget: IREF 10 uA + tail 6 uA + I2 8 uA = 24 uA, giving 47.5 uW at 1.98 V. Inverter static current is about 0."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (20, 12, 24),        # input pair gm/Id
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (10, 7, 14),         # PMOS mirror load + 2nd-stage PMOS (same density)
    "L_p":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.4),
    "Itail":   (6e-6, 3e-6, 9e-6),
    "I2":      (8e-6, 4e-6, 10e-6),
    "Wn_inv":  (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),
    "Wp_inv":  (4.0, 1.5, 10.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Lb, gmid_b = 1.0, 12.0
    It, I2 = p["Itail"], p["I2"]

    # bias mirror (NMOS, L=1, all same gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, It, vds=0.25)
    m6 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, I2, vds=0.8)

    # input pair and PMOS mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], It / 2, vds=0.9)
    # second stage PMOS: same L and gm/Id as mirror load -> current = I2 at balance
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M5", "o2", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    Wn, Wp = p["Wn_inv"], p["Wp_inv"]
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m5.gm / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    Cx = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m5.cgg + m5.cgd + 1e-15
    tau1 = Cx * A1 / m1.gm
    t1 = tau1 * math.log(2)
    cox = 8.5e-15  # F/um^2
    Cinv = (Wn + Wp) * 0.15 * cox + (Wn + Wp) * 0.4e-15
    Co2 = Cinv + m5.cdd + m6.cdd + 1e-15
    # second stage: pull-down limited by I2, pull-up ~ (overdriven M5 - I2)
    i_up = max(0.8 * I2, 1e-7)
    t2 = Co2 * 0.5 * vdd / min(i_up, I2)
    # inverter: crude saturation current estimate
    i_inv = 60e-6 * min(Wn, Wp / 3)
    t3 = cl * 0.5 * vdd / i_inv + 0.2e-9
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = 1.98 * (iref + It + I2)
    offset = 0.3 / (A1 * A2)  # systematic: ~0.3 V stage-2 trip mismatch referred to input
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1, "offset": offset}
